 Inter, change in goal: against Fiorentina and Venezia it is Provedel's turn
 Calcio 
 Martinez has regained composure, Chivu can finally unleash the backup goalkeeper. Pepo returns for the derby
 Roberto Maida 
 24 october (modifica alle 12:21) - MILANO 
 Italian version 
 Scegli Gazzetta come fonte preferita su Google 
 If at the end of the match he utters the usual cliché about a childhood dream coming true, about the long wait for an unforgettable moment, it will not be empty talk: Ivan Provedel has always been an Inter fan, and in the summer he finally got to wear the shirt of his heart, following relatively straightforward negotiations with Lazio. But tomorrow he will experience an even greater thrill, because he will make his debut at San Siro as a starter .
 VIDEO: Inter, Chivu: "Bastoni provocato, ma è stato ingenuo" 
 Make way for the backup
—   The change of goalkeeper had been in the air for weeks, answering the need to keep the backup sharp and ready. But Chivu had delayed it to strengthen the position of Josep Martinez, responsible for several very visible errors , and to give the new arrival time to regain confidence with gloves and distances. Provedel's last match dates back to the start of March: then a shoulder injury put him out of action, preventing him from saying goodbye to his former fans and playing the Coppa Italia final, against Inter of all teams.
 Hierarchy
—   Now Ivan is relishing his big opportunity, which according to the coaching staff's plans will not remain an isolated one: the backup will also play on Wednesday at Venezia to gain continuity, before handing the reins back to Martinez for the derby on Saturday 31. We shall see in the future: the hierarchy between the two exists, but is subject to change . It cannot be ruled out that Chivu might decide to alternate goalkeepers between the league and cup competitions. It will depend on the reliability of both over the coming weeks.
